field_replacements.predecessor_value: Source classification targets and numeric results are recoverable, but the complete registered paper program includes original reconstruction and spatial-scale/pretraining analyses whose H/checkpoints, exact reconstruction evaluation and authentic split/source-clock bindings remain unresolved. A paper–code session-label discrepancy also needs resolution. The local chronological AUC aggregate or source-amended reconstruction MSE cannot by itself establish surpassing BaRISTA on its original full task.
field_replacements.successor_value: The explicitly selected primary is the complete fixed-channel-mask spatial-encoding comparison on sentence-onset and speech/non-speech, including chronological sensitivity. Ordered positive-class ROC-AUC endpoints exist, but authentic source support, fixed competent references, matched exposure/search budgets and defensible endpoint-specific improvement/uncertainty remain unresolved. Wider reconstruction/factorial/pretraining/scaling results are separate evidence; their gaps do not automatically block this primary. Candidate reproduction success is not a prerequisite to independently justified superiority.

predecessor_value.rationale: The paper pools 35 or 175 measurements for reported means. Those counts are not independent biological sample sizes. The intended population claim and complete source pairing must be settled before choosing valid intervals/tests.

field_replacements.successor_value: Complete original source channels and spatial labels for each selected three-second iEEG language segment, permitted training/development labels and authenticated source pretraining/checkpoint exposure. field_replacements.predecessor_value: Classification ROC-AUC is the probability a positive score ranks above a negative, with half credit for ties, computed over all queries in a session/seed/fold. Native code uses roc_auc_score. Reconstruction reports MSE and R², but historical evaluation denominator/flattening and full reconstruction producer are not recovered; training token loss and locally declared MSE are different quantities.
field_replacements.successor_value: Semantic-positive-class ROC-AUC for each selected language task, computed from all source query probabilities and labels within the original session/finetuning-seed/fold context, with half credit for score ties. Native source uses roc_auc_score. Random and chronological conditions remain separate; no cross-task scalar is a selected finding. Reconstruction MSE/R2 is separately retained source evidence, not this primary metric.

Exact historical SEM and channel/session reconstruction weighting remain unresolved; the rounded available-cell helper is not sufficient provenance.
